title: Norseen report under NASA weather contract N66001
place_text: Navy SPAWAR Systems Center, San Diego

tellings.quote: According to Norseen citation, that report was funded under the contract N66001. [music]

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a report from around 2000 by a researcher named John Norseen, titled Biofusion, Reflexive Control and Neuro-ergonomic Integration in Adaptive Cockpits, which is about fitting aircraft cockpits to the pilot's brain. Michels says that, by Norseen's own citation, the report was paid for under contract N66001, a contract the story links to NASA weather work and to the Navy's SPAWAR Systems Center in San Diego, a Navy research center for communications and electronics. If true, it would show brain-related research being funded under a contract with an unrelated label.
